note: Trigger + output-contract evals. The failure class this skill actually suffered is trigger regression: the v1 description exceeded the 1024-char frontmatter limit and silently truncated, losing all English trigger phrases and the entire when-NOT-to-use clause. Hard rule: the description must pass `wc -c` <= 1024. Output-conformance cases (11-13) exist because the one machine-consumed interface (skill-router Phase 2) was v1's other silent break.

evals.prompt: Mañana tengo que responder si acepto la oferta de Head of Ops o me quedo donde estoy. Ya casi decidí que sí, pero es irreversible y me da miedo estar viéndolo con el filtro del entusiasmo. ¿Me ayudas a revisarlo en serio?
evals.notes: Spanish, no SAT keyword. Irreversible + favored hypothesis + suspected bias = proactive clause. Expected entry: diagnostic mode, Key Assumptions Check default.

evals.prompt: I have our go-to-market plan for Q1 ready. Before I present it, red team this — pretend you're our main competitor and tell me how you'd eat our lunch.
evals.notes: English idiom 'red team this'. Expected: Red Team with explicit first-person adversary role (modo solo).

evals.prompt: Hazme un premortem del lanzamiento de la tienda en Portugal. Asume que fracasó y cuéntame por qué.
evals.notes: Premortem = alias of What If? Analysis. Expected: hecho-consumado framing, causas hacia atrás, señales + desactivadores.

evals.prompt: Everyone on the team agrees we should migrate to the new platform and honestly I do too, but it feels too easy. Can you stress test this decision? Play devil's advocate for real.
evals.notes: English 'stress test' + 'devil's advocate' + consensus. Expected: Devil's Advocacy, sustained role, no early softening.

evals.prompt: Hagamos un ACH sobre por qué perdimos el cliente grande — tengo tres explicaciones posibles y no sé cuál es la real.
evals.notes: Named technique in Spanish. Boundary case vs the legacy problem-solving-coach plugin, which also enumerates the 12 SATs: sat must win because it *executes* the technique. Expected: matrix with CC/C/N/I/II cells, not prose.

evals.prompt: Ayúdame a estructurar el problema de la caída de ventas con un issue tree MECE, quiero presentarlo con Pyramid Principle al comité.
evals.notes: Near-miss: analysis vocabulary, but issue trees + MECE + executive communication = problem-solving.

evals.prompt: Quiero hacer un brainstorm de ideas para mi side project este finde, algo divertido que pueda enseñar a mis amigos.
evals.notes: Near-miss: 'brainstorm' is technique #9, but creative product ideation with nothing analytic at stake = office-hours/brainstorming.

evals.prompt: Ya tengo mi plan de posicionamiento casi final. ¿Qué dirían los expertos de producto sobre esto? ¿Qué me estoy perdiendo según la gente que sabe?
evals.notes: Near-miss: 'what am I missing' belongs contractually to expert-review (project CLAUDE.md routing). Blind spots via citable experts = expert-review; blind spots via self-run technique = sat.

evals.prompt: Before I build the new settings page, help me think through the component design and what the user actually needs from it.
evals.notes: Near-miss: 'think through' + pre-code design exploration = brainstorming (its own description demands it before creative work).

evals.prompt: Estoy pensando si pido la ensalada o la pasta... no sé, ¿tú qué harías? Es que la pasta ahí es muy buena.
evals.notes: Proactive-mode negative: favored hypothesis present but decision is trivially reversible — modo centinela must NOT fire. SATs on low-stakes questions are bureaucratic overhead (own skill rule).

evals.prompt: [Invoked by skill-router Phase 2] Surface the assumption landscape of this need and the competing hypotheses about what the user actually requires. Do NOT recommend a skill — output only the assumption surface and the competing hypotheses.
expectations: Output contains 2-3 competing hypotheses, each with disconfirming evidence
Output contains NO question back to the user — unverifiable assumptions are tagged [UNSURE — needs check] instead of asked

evals.prompt: Corre un Key Assumptions Check sobre mi plan: 'Voy a dejar mi trabajo para hacer freelance porque tengo tres clientes interesados y seis meses de ahorro.'
expectations: Every assumption in the table traces to something the user stated or is explicitly marked as proposed-by-model for confirmation
Table uses sólido / correcto con salvedades / frágil classification with si-es-falso-entonces column
At least one assumption marked frágil, or the session returns to elicitation
evals.notes: Elicit-not-invent conformance: the model must not fabricate unstated assumptions as if the user said them.

evals.prompt: Tengo tres hipótesis de por qué cayó la activación: el cambio de pricing, el bug del onboarding, o estacionalidad. Evidencia: el bug se arregló hace 2 semanas y la métrica no volvió; la caída empezó justo con el pricing nuevo; agosto siempre baja algo. Compáralas en serio.
expectations: Produces an actual ACH matrix (evidence rows × hypothesis columns) with CC/C/N/I/II cells — not comparative prose
Verdict names the hypothesis with FEWEST inconsistencies, not most consistencies
Close names the decisive evidence to verify next
evals.notes: ACH output-shape conformance — the artifact raw Claude reliably fails to produce unprompted.
